description: This file implements a speech transcription pipeline using Pipecat framework, integrating VAD analysis, Whisper STT service, and custom latency measurement. It sets up transport parameters, defines a transcription logger class, and runs the pipeline asynchronously.

classes.name: TranscriptionLogger
classes.description: A FrameProcessor subclass that measures and logs transcription latency based on frame types and timing.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the TranscriptionLogger, setting the last transcription time.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes each frame, logs latency if user stopped speaking, updates last transcription time on transcription frames, and pushes frames through.
